title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
blurb: Sped up sampling from large language models two to three times, with an identical output distribution, by verifying a small model's guesses in parallel.
intro: Decoding is memory-bound, so scoring several positions costs the large model about as much as scoring one. A small draft model proposes a few tokens, the target model scores them all in one pass, and a modified rejection-sampling rule accepts a prefix and corrects the first mismatch so the output follows the target distribution exactly. The steps build ordinary sampling, the acceptance test and residual resampling in numpy and JAX; the capstone runs the complete draft-verify loop with two bigram models.

steps.name: Accept, reject and resample in JAX
